banner.title: Privacy settings
banner.description: Invessiv uses necessary functions and, on this landing page, Google Analytics and Google Ads to evaluate page views, interactions, and quote requests with technical device and browser data. Data may be transferred to Google in the United States. You control analytics and marketing here; details are available in the Privacy Policy.

necessary.title: Necessary
necessary.description: Required so the website loads securely and basic functions work. This category cannot be disabled.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.description: Helps us understand which pages and content get used, via Google Analytics. We only enable full analytics measurement with your consent.

marketing.title: Marketing
marketing.description: Enables Google Ads conversion tracking so we can correctly measure quote requests from ads. We only record Ads conversions with your consent.
